Also stabbing 20 people with knife: that's "故意伤害罪". Multiple victims, many injuries. Could be "故意伤害罪" (intentional injury). Possibly "聚众斗殴"? But he acted alone with knife, causing injuries. That includes causing explosion. So likely "危害公共安全罪". Also "故意伤害罪". Also maybe "非法持有刀具"? Not needed.
